anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: 2.0 mbar, consistent with the preceding baseline of 1.7–2.3 mbar.
PDI702 abruptly increased to 5.7 mbar while PY23 fell to 293.9 mbar and PDI701 changed to 0.0 mbar.
PDI702 remained elevated at 5.0 mbar; PY23 partially recovered to 296.6 mbar and PDI701 remained 0.0 mbar.
Level switches remained at 1.0; reflux and distillate flows were 0.8 and 0.2 L/h. No composition measurement was provided.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol phase and commanded changes at the pressure transition; independent pressure-drop verification and vapor-path inspection to distinguish a process restriction from a planned transition or sensor error; product composition and target specification to evaluate separation. Temperature readings are unavailable from the listed uninstalled sensors.
